label: Subject focal role controls, checked
description: One joint populated finite certificate. Carrier Control.B (four named individuals), one world, existsAt, substance, primary 0 and creature remain fixed in causal and degree cells. Changing common to split changes only subject assignment and preserves role extensions. Product Bool degrees are incomparable; natural-number degrees are comparable, and noMore fails the exact approach biconditional where totalMore succeeds. All three bridge omissions have explicit counterexamples. No full Aristotle/Aquinas interpretation or metaphysical possibility established.

research_comparisons.conditions: SubjectFocalReading existsAt substance common, CreatureSubjectBridge, CommonCenter at 0. Controls proves OrderedToPrimaryAsCauseReading for subjectCause and its negation for noCause; efficient content is supplied independently by the named assignment.
research_comparisons.scope: Same Control.B (four named individuals) individuals, one implicit world, existence, substance, common inherence, HasBeing, Creature and primary 0. Only CausesIn changes between the two assignments. This tests a candidate instance of the exact interface, not full sourced BEING_4.
research_comparisons.coverage: Only primary substance and secondary subject-dependent accident accounts. No claim to all focal roles or all BEING_4 meanings.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The two candidate accounts are disjoint by endpoint constraints, as roleDiversity proves; this does not select a historical reading or exclude rival frameworks.
research_comparisons.witness: Control.common edges 2->0 and 3->0; subjects 0 and 1, accidents 2 and 3. Control.subjectCause satisfies and noCause violates the interface in the SAME nonempty interpretation.
research_comparisons.next_step: Test whether the subject-to-efficient-cause translation is philosophically applicable to this same dependence, and separately whether all intended creatures can be secondary subjects.

research_comparisons.scope: Same Control.B (four named individuals), one implicit world, existence, substance, common inherence, HasBeing, Creature and primary 0 throughout. Only the expressly named degree map/order or MoreIn changes. Causal assignments are independent.

research_comparisons.next_step: Supply a nonstipulative approach interpretation/calibration for the same intended full BEING_4 meaning; neither arbitrary finite grading nor subject dependence provides it.

research_comparisons.conditions: The closed controls interpret only the new analyst subject/accident body. No theorem binds full BEING_4 to this candidate.
research_comparisons.scope: Original diverse-rationes, substance-focal and God/creature source meanings kept distinct. Missing mappings are not model compatibility or countermodels to the original definition.

research_comparisons.next_step: Interpret another load-bearing focal role, e.g. privation, without identifying subject dependence with efficient production; compare against this candidate on the same domain.

research_comparisons.conditions: The common assignment has exactly one common subject center 0 and a distinct substantial individual 1. The split assignment has no common center. Both satisfy SubjectFocalReading.
research_comparisons.scope: Same four named individuals, one implicit world, existence, substance extension {0,1} and secondary extension {2,3}. Only Inheres changes, from 2->0 and 3->0 to 2->0 and 3->1. This is a comparison of common primary instances, not an identification of God.
research_comparisons.coverage: Only these two subject assignments; not all focal relations or philosophical primary meanings.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: Each finite assignment fixes its explicit subject dictionary; no intended historical reading is selected.
research_comparisons.witness: Controls proves forall p, CommonCenter substance common p iff p=0, existence of another substance 1, and not exists p, CommonCenter substance split p, with populated accounts in both.
research_comparisons.next_step: Find an independent same-instance bridge if the intended application needs one primary rather than one kind of primary; a shared subject role does not provide this.
